text: Not every visit needs a doctor's exam. A tech visit, like a nail trim, is written up as a medical note, and a licensed tech can sign it.

Wrap up stays grey, and says why. Write it up, and ask a licensed tech or the doctor to sign it the same day.
Doctors can sign these too. But if you examined the pet, use a SOAP.
Two mistakes to avoid: using a medical note for a doctor's exam, and leaving it unsigned. Pick the right record, and get it signed today.
